board_run_note: This is a pre-measurement prediction and harness contract. No device, Docker, Podman, or tt-smi operation is performed while preparing this plan.

measurement_scope.run_duration_definition: The fixed workload interval targets 285 seconds of sustained device work; setup and teardown are outside the interval.
measurement_scope.run_guard_definition: The workload subprocess timeout and harness deadline are both 330 seconds. A run that reaches the guard is failed, never extended.
measurement_scope.inter_run_cooldown: Required between runs 1 and 2, and between runs 2 and 3. The cooldown is outside the 285-second workload interval and is not an excuse to extend the 330-second run guard.

workload.name: adr-0013-108-core-newton-schulz-surrogate
workload.note: This is the existing Issue #118 surrogate. Q2 does not introduce a second arithmetic path or claim image-quality evidence.

units.current_a: A as reported by snapshot telemetry
units.voltage_v: V as reported by snapshot telemetry

trace.common_time_axis: timestamp_monotonic_ns; each row brackets one read-only tt-smi snapshot and positive-duration left-held segments are used for integration.

identity.identity_source: selected device_info[].board_info in each snapshot plus the requested board_id/bus_id pair

trace.sampling_interval_note: The interval is a harness sampling cadence, not an analysis time base. Pre-run, in-run, and post-run captures use the same command path.

raw_window.source: raw trace rows from run_start_monotonic_ns through the first 10 seconds

source_snapshot.source_note: Limit facts below were read from the already acquired host snapshot supplied for this preparation. The snapshot is not reacquired here and tt-smi must not be run during preparation.
source_snapshot.raw_smbus_policy: Keep raw SMBus key spelling and value spelling exactly as emitted by the snapshot. Do not assign units or derive a missing key.

THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE.status: not established by the prior snapshot; no value is inferred

thm_limit_throttle.status: unknown when absent from source snapshot; analysis must report unknown/not_evaluable rather than substitute a value

plateau.interval_definition: [run_start_monotonic_ns + 150 s, run_start_monotonic_ns + 285 s); a sample at the left boundary is held until the next sample.

statistics.aiclk_min: Minimum AICLK over positive-duration left-held plateau segments.
statistics.aiclk_max: Maximum AICLK over positive-duration left-held plateau segments.
statistics.aiclk_time_weighted_mean: Sum(value * segment_duration) / plateau_duration using timestamp_monotonic_ns; no extrapolation.
statistics.percentiles: Duration-weighted nearest-rank percentiles over positive-duration left-held segments. p0 is the first value, p100 the last, and pXX is the first sorted value whose cumulative duration reaches XX percent of plateau duration.
statistics.signal_aggregates: For power, board power, current, voltage, and ASIC temperature, report min, max, duration-weighted mean, and limit proximity where a source limit exists.
statistics.limit_proximity: absolute(plateau_time_weighted - limit) / absolute(limit); a threshold is evaluated only when signal and limit units are comparable and the limit has source provenance.
statistics.onset_timestamp: The start of the first left-held segment at or after run start whose value reaches the hypothesis's source-specific onset threshold; null means no onset was observed.
statistics.onset_order: A hypothesis passes when its signal onset is present and no later than the first AICLK drop onset. Equal timestamps are allowed.

hypotheses.correlation_warning: A matching plateau and onset order are correlations consistent with a hypothesis, not proof of causation.

aiclk_drop.baseline: source snapshot limits.asic_fmax (1350 MHz); never infer a baseline from the plateau trace
aiclk_drop.onset_definition: from run_start_monotonic_ns, first left-held segment with AICLK <= asic_fmax * (1 - 0.05)

plateau_proximity.criterion: current_a plateau time-weighted mean is within 10 percent of TDC_LIMIT_MAX, with comparable units

onset.criterion: current onset at or above 90 percent of the TDC limit is no later than AICLK drop onset

H-TDC.classification: supported only when plateau proximity and onset order pass; otherwise not_supported or inconclusive when a required value is unavailable

plateau_proximity.criterion: ASIC temperature plateau time-weighted mean is within 5 degC of therm trip L1 and remains below THM shutdown

onset.criterion: temperature onset at therm_trip_l1 - 5 degC is no later than AICLK drop onset

thm_limit_throttle.criterion: when present in the pre/post source snapshots, compare the run plateau maximum ASIC temperature with THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE and retain the comparison as provenance
thm_limit_throttle.missing_limit_policy: unknown/not_evaluable; do not infer THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE from therm_trip_l1 or shutdown
thm_limit_throttle.classification_role: reported optional comparison, not a replacement for therm_trip_l1, shutdown, or onset criteria

H-THM.classification: supported only when temperature proximity, onset order, and shutdown bound pass

H-TDP.reference: Issue #118 plateau 132-135 W versus TDP 150 W

plateau_proximity.criterion: power_w plateau time-weighted mean is at least TDP_LIMIT_MAX * (1 - 0.05) and within 5 percent of TDP_LIMIT_MAX

onset.criterion: power_w reaches the 5 percent lower-bound onset no later than AICLK drop onset

board_power_reporting.criterion: report board_power_w plateau proximity to BOARD_POWER_LIMIT using the same 5 percent limit-near form; this is reporting only and is not the H-TDP signal criterion

H-TDP.reference_only: Issue #118 plateau 132-135 W remains a prediction/reference and is not an H-TDP support criterion
H-TDP.classification: supported only when the TDP proximity and onset-order criteria pass

H-OTHER.criterion: Fallback only when none of H-TDC, H-THM, and H-TDP is supported; it is not a fourth numeric hypothesis.

onset_order.criterion: Report every observed onset timestamp and do not force a known-limit attribution when no known hypothesis is supported.

H-OTHER.classification: H-OTHER is a fallback classification only; it is not a causal explanation.

prediction.current_a: indeterminate: no historical Issue #118 current trace
prediction.expected_classification_note: H-TDC or H-OTHER; H-TDP and H-THM are unsupported by the prior evidence.

hypotheses.H-TDP: unsupported: 132-135 W is below the 5 percent lower bound of 142.5 W for TDP_LIMIT_MAX=150 W
hypotheses.H-THM: unsupported: approximately 81 degC does not enter the 5 degC proximity band of therm_trip_l1=90 degC
hypotheses.H-TDC: indeterminate: historical current evidence is absent; the Q2 run determines it

prediction_mismatch_policy: If H-TDP is supported, investigate the difference between the Issue #118 132-135 W condition and the Q2 source-limit/onset evidence before revising the hypothesis.
If H-THM is supported near the predicted 81 degC, audit therm_trip_l1 provenance and the trace limits before revising the prediction.
If H-TDC is supported, retain the current trace and compare it with the absent Issue #118 current evidence rather than treating the prediction as a prior measurement.

cooldown.baseline_source: run-1 pre-run snapshot for the first transition; immediately preceding run pre-run snapshot thereafter
cooldown.criterion: latest usable idle snapshot has board power <= baseline + 5 W and ASIC temperature <= baseline + 3 degC
cooldown.aiclk: Record idle AICLK as provenance only; the expected 800 MHz idle value is not a cooldown gate.
cooldown.failure_policy: Do not start the next 285-second run after the cap or an unavailable required reading.

provenance.persisted_output_paths: Basenames or container-relative /out names only; no hostname, username, worktree path, or user-specific absolute path is retained.
provenance.trace_source: The immutable extended-v1 trace and its pre/post snapshot records are the source for every analysis fact.
provenance.revision_binding: The harness commit is recorded before a board run and the measurement record remains bound to that revision.

revision_history.change: Created the pre-measurement Q2 plan from the existing ADR-0013 and Issue #118 108-core surrogate, fixing device 1, three 300-second runs, the 330-second guard, extended-v1 fields, hypothesis thresholds, cooldown gate, and source-snapshot provenance.

pre-measurement change 300 -> 285 load and 150-300 -> 150-285 plateau to fit existing 40-second margin and 330-second guard; criteria and prediction unchanged; triggered by 8ad7ea9 preflight rejection with 0 device frames.

limitations: No board measurement is included in this preparation artifact.
The THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE value is intentionally absent when the source snapshot does not establish it; its optional run-trace comparison is then unknown/not_evaluable.
The hypothesis labels describe criterion-compatible correlations only and do not establish a physical cause.
A 2 second sample cadence limits onset ordering and causality-resolution claims to approximately 2 seconds; no interpolation is performed.
When limits metadata omits asic_fmax_mhz, AICLK drop onset is unknown/not_evaluable rather than inferred as 1350 MHz.
